introHtml: Custom swimming badge ID holders are built to withstand chlorine, saltwater, and constant moisture, making them ideal for lifeguards, swim instructors, and aquatic facility staff. Unlike standard badge holders that fog up or degrade in wet environments, these holders feature waterproof seals and durable materials that keep IDs visible and dry. Choose from clear PVC pouches or silicone wristbands with badge slots for a secure, hands-free option during swim meets or daily pool operations.
